Objective
Learn alternate interior angles and solve for missing measures.
Parallel lines
Two parallel lines never intersect in the same plane.
Transversal
A transversal crosses two lines at different points.
Interior
Interior angles lie between the two lines.
Alternate
Alternate means opposite sides of the transversal.
Top angles
Angles three and four are inside below the upper line.
Bottom angles
Angles five and six are inside above the lower line.
Pair one
Angles three and five are alternate interior angles.
Pair two
Angles four and six are alternate interior angles.
Rule
For parallel lines, alternate interior angles are equal.
First example
If angle three is sixty four, angle five is sixty four.
Linear pair
Adjacent angles on a straight line total one hundred eighty.
Neighbor
One hundred eighty minus sixty four is one hundred sixteen.
Equation
Two x plus ten equals seventy when the angles match.
Solve
Subtract ten and divide by two to find x equals thirty.
Two expressions
Five x plus five equals three x plus thirty one.
Check
X equals thirteen and both angles are seventy degrees.
Converse
Equal alternate interior angles prove the lines parallel.
Challenge
Four x plus eighteen equals seven x minus twenty four; x is fourteen.
Finish
The adjacent angle is one hundred six. Complete the practice and test.
